verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Neon documentation showing that a developer can choose regions for data or place read replicas near users worldwide. The Read Replicas page appears only as a bare title, with no content about cross-region placement or latency. The only region mention covers AI Gateway availability, a different feature, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide
